archetype_reasoning: As a B2B SaaS dashboard requiring clarity, density, and authority, the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype fits perfectly. It uses a stark monochrome palette with sparse, functional colors for data visualization and critical actions.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact spacing.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Center-align only if strictly needed for visual hierarchy.

components.strategy: Shadcn components, highly customized. Avoid excessive card usage—go cardless, rectangular, flat, and dense.
components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges (rounded-none). Primary: black bg, white text. Secondary: transparent, 1px black border. Explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-gray-900 hover:text-white).
components.inputs: Flat, 1px border, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:border-black, rounded-none.
components.tables: Dense rows, left-aligned, sticky headers, subtle border-b on rows. No alternating background colors.
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn charts. Use the high-contrast chart_palette.
components.navigation: Sticky top nav with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80, 1px bottom border.
components.modals: Backdrop blur on overlay, solid white background for modal surface, sharp borders.

motion.hover: Subtle background shifts or border darkening. Button hovers must explicitly define text color.

icons.style: Regular or bold, avoiding overly thin line weights. Dense and functional.

testing.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive and key informational elements. Format: kebab-case, role-based.

login_background.description: Minimalist architecture, clean light. Use as a split-screen background for the Auth layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install fonts: Use @fontsource for Cabinet Grotesk and IBM Plex Sans, or add to HTML head.
Initialize Shadcn with CSS variables and apply the stark monochrome palette to `tailwind.config.js`.
Ensure all dashboard widgets stretch to fill their grid cells (use `h-full`).
For the drag-and-drop builder, use `dnd-kit` or `@hello-pangea/dnd`.
